title: Character Strengths
source: IPIP-VIA (public-domain analog of the VIA Inventory of Strengths), 213 items / 24 strengths. Items transcribed verbatim from ipip.ori.org/newVIAKey.htm; see content-sources/strengths.md.
citation: Peterson, C., & Seligman, M. E. P. (2004). Character Strengths and Virtues (VIA framework). Items: International Personality Item Pool VIA scales (public domain), ipip.ori.org. Goldberg, L. R. et al. (2006).
intro: These statements look at twenty-four character strengths, grouped under six broad virtues. There are no good or bad scores — this maps what you tend to lead with, and every strength has a shadow as well as a light. Answer for how you generally are.

sections.title: Before you start
sections.body: Character is about values, not ability — which strengths you reach for, not a ranking of worth. Read the bands as tendencies, and remember that an over-used strength can become a weakness, while a lower one can be grown.

scales.name: Wisdom & Knowledge
scales.construct_explainer: Wisdom strengths are about gaining and using knowledge — curiosity, judgement, and perspective.

low.shadow: May skip learning that would help.
low.one_thing_to_try: Follow one curiosity this week.

balanced.light: Thinks and learns when it counts.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Ask one harder question than usual.

high.light: Strong pull toward ideas, learning, and good judgement.
high.shadow: Analysis can crowd out action.
high.one_thing_to_try: Act on one thing before fully researching it.

scales.name: Courage
scales.construct_explainer: Courage strengths are the will to pursue goals against opposition — bravery, perseverance, honesty, and energy.

low.shadow: May avoid worthwhile risks and hard truths.
low.one_thing_to_try: Say one true, slightly risky thing.

balanced.light: Stands up and pushes on when it matters.
balanced.shadow: Resolve can waver under real pressure.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Name one fear worth facing this week.

high.light: Faces fear, hardship, and opposition head-on.
high.shadow: Boldness can override caution and others.
high.one_thing_to_try: Pause once to check the risk before charging in.

scales.name: Humanity
scales.construct_explainer: Humanity strengths are about caring relationships — love, kindness, and reading people well.

low.one_thing_to_try: Do one warm thing for someone today.

balanced.light: Connects and helps without losing self.
balanced.shadow: Care can run hot and cold.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Reach out to one person you have lost touch with.

high.light: Warm, generous, and tuned in to others.
high.shadow: Giving can run past your own needs.
high.one_thing_to_try: Notice one time to care for yourself first.

scales.name: Justice
scales.construct_explainer: Justice strengths underpin healthy group life — teamwork, fairness, and leadership.

low.one_thing_to_try: Contribute one thing to a shared effort.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Take responsibility for one shared outcome.

high.light: Builds fair, well-functioning groups.
high.shadow: Group focus can submerge your own view.
high.one_thing_to_try: Voice one personal need inside the group.

scales.name: Temperance
scales.construct_explainer: Temperance strengths protect against excess — forgiveness, humility, prudence, and self-control.

low.shadow: Excess and impulse can cause harm.
low.one_thing_to_try: Add one small pause before one reaction.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Spot the situation that most tests your restraint.

high.light: Disciplined, humble, and measured.
high.shadow: Control can tip into rigidity or self-denial.
high.one_thing_to_try: Let one thing be loose and unplanned.

scales.name: Transcendence
scales.construct_explainer: Transcendence strengths connect to meaning and the larger world — beauty, gratitude, hope, humour, and spirituality.

low.shadow: May miss sources of meaning and lift.
low.one_thing_to_try: Notice one thing worth appreciating today.

balanced.light: Finds meaning and lift in good moments.
balanced.shadow: Can lose it on a grey stretch.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Name one thing worth being grateful for.

high.light: Rich sense of meaning, beauty, and hope.
high.shadow: Optimism can skip over real problems.
high.one_thing_to_try: Sit with one hard reality before reframing it.

scales.name: Creativity
scales.construct_explainer: Creativity reflects coming up with original, useful ideas and new ways of doing things.

low.one_thing_to_try: Brainstorm three new ways to do one task.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Build out one new idea this week.

high.light: A fountain of original ideas.
high.shadow: Novelty can outrun the practical.
high.one_thing_to_try: Carry one idea all the way to done.

scales.name: Curiosity
scales.construct_explainer: Curiosity reflects active interest in the world and openness to new experience.

low.light: Content and focused on the familiar.
low.one_thing_to_try: Investigate one thing you usually ignore.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Chase one question to its answer.

high.light: Fascinated by almost everything.
high.shadow: Can scatter across too many interests.
high.one_thing_to_try: Go deep on one interest, not five.

scales.name: Judgment
scales.construct_explainer: Judgment reflects thinking things through, weighing evidence, and not jumping to conclusions.

low.one_thing_to_try: Weigh pros and cons on one choice.

balanced.light: Reasons things out when it matters.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Seek one view that challenges yours.

high.light: Careful, objective, evidence-led.
high.shadow: Over-analysis can stall decisions.
high.one_thing_to_try: Decide one small thing fast.

scales.name: Love of Learning
scales.construct_explainer: Love of Learning reflects mastering new skills and knowledge for its own sake.

low.light: Learns what is needed, no more.
low.one_thing_to_try: Learn one thing outside requirements.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Finish one thing you started learning.

high.light: Loves learning broadly and deeply.
high.shadow: Can collect knowledge without using it.
high.one_thing_to_try: Apply one thing you learned this week.

scales.name: Perspective
scales.construct_explainer: Perspective reflects seeing the bigger picture and giving wise counsel.

low.light: Stays close to the concrete and immediate.
low.one_thing_to_try: Zoom out on one current problem.

balanced.light: Sees the wider view when prompted.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Ask what matters most in one situation.

high.light: Reads the big picture and advises well.
high.shadow: Big-picture focus can miss specifics.
high.one_thing_to_try: Check one detail you would normally skip.

scales.name: Bravery
scales.construct_explainer: Bravery reflects facing threats, challenges, or pain without backing down.

low.one_thing_to_try: Face one small thing you have avoided.

balanced.shadow: Nerve can fail at the moment.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Voice one unpopular but honest view.

high.light: Faces fear and opposition head-on.
high.shadow: Can charge in without weighing cost.
high.one_thing_to_try: Check the risk once before acting.

scales.name: Perseverance
scales.construct_explainer: Perseverance reflects finishing what is started despite obstacles.

low.one_thing_to_try: Finish one thing before the next.

balanced.light: Pushes through most of the time.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Name the next small step on a stalled task.

high.light: Sees things through, obstacles and all.
high.shadow: Can grind on past the point of sense.
high.one_thing_to_try: Drop one goal that no longer serves.

scales.name: Honesty
scales.construct_explainer: Honesty reflects telling the truth and being genuine and true to oneself.

low.light: Tactful and adaptable in what you share.
low.one_thing_to_try: Say one plain true thing today.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Be direct on one thing you would hedge.

high.light: Straight, genuine, true to your values.
high.shadow: Bluntness can cost tact.
high.one_thing_to_try: Add care to one hard truth without bending it.

scales.name: Zest
scales.construct_explainer: Zest reflects approaching life with energy, excitement, and full engagement.

low.one_thing_to_try: Throw yourself fully into one thing.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Start one thing you can get excited about.

high.light: Bursting with energy and enthusiasm.
high.shadow: High pace can burn out or overwhelm.
high.one_thing_to_try: Protect one slow, restful block.

scales.name: Capacity for Love
scales.construct_explainer: Capacity for Love reflects valuing and sustaining close, caring relationships.

low.shadow: Closeness can be held at arm’s length.
low.one_thing_to_try: Share one real feeling with someone.

balanced.light: Close to a few, careful with the rest.
balanced.shadow: Can drift from people when busy.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Reconnect with one person this week.

high.light: Deeply bonded and openly caring.
high.shadow: Can lose self in others’ needs.
high.one_thing_to_try: Name one of your own needs out loud.

scales.name: Kindness
scales.construct_explainer: Kindness reflects doing good for others and helping generously.

low.one_thing_to_try: Do one unasked favour.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Cheer up one person who seems down.

high.light: Generous and quick to help.
high.shadow: Giving can run past your limits.
high.one_thing_to_try: Say no to one ask to protect yourself.

scales.name: Social Intelligence
scales.construct_explainer: Social Intelligence reflects reading people and situations and acting well on it.

low.light: Direct and unfussed by social nuance.
low.one_thing_to_try: Notice one person’s mood before speaking.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Name what one person seems to feel.

high.light: Sharp at reading people and fitting in.
high.shadow: Tuning to others can mask your own view.
high.one_thing_to_try: Say one thing that is simply yours.

scales.name: Teamwork
scales.construct_explainer: Teamwork reflects working well as a member of a group and pulling your weight.

low.one_thing_to_try: Show up fully for one group task.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Back one teammate this week.

high.light: Loyal, contributing team player.
high.shadow: Group loyalty can submerge your view.
high.one_thing_to_try: Voice one honest dissent in a group.

scales.name: Fairness
scales.construct_explainer: Fairness reflects treating people equally and by principles of justice.

low.one_thing_to_try: Check one decision for even-handedness.

balanced.shadow: Fairness can slip when stakes are personal.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Give one person a fairer hearing.

high.light: Even-handed and principled.
high.shadow: Strict fairness can ignore context.
high.one_thing_to_try: Weigh one case on its specifics.

scales.name: Leadership
scales.construct_explainer: Leadership reflects organising group activity and helping a group get things done.

low.one_thing_to_try: Take the lead on one small thing.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Organise one shared task.

high.light: Rallies and organises groups well.
high.shadow: Taking charge can crowd others out.
high.one_thing_to_try: Hand one decision to the group.

scales.name: Forgiveness
scales.construct_explainer: Forgiveness reflects letting go of resentment and giving people second chances.

low.light: Holds clear boundaries with those who wrong you.
low.one_thing_to_try: Release one small grudge.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Offer one fresh start.

high.light: Quick to forgive and move on.
high.shadow: Forgiving too fast can invite repeat harm.
high.one_thing_to_try: Set one boundary alongside forgiving.

scales.name: Humility
scales.construct_explainer: Humility reflects letting accomplishments speak for themselves and not seeking the spotlight.

low.light: Comfortable owning strengths and standing out.
low.one_thing_to_try: Credit one other person out loud.

balanced.shadow: Can over- or under-claim by context.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: State one real strength plainly.

high.light: Modest and unassuming.
high.shadow: Modesty can hide real ability.
high.one_thing_to_try: Take credit for one thing you did.

scales.name: Prudence
scales.construct_explainer: Prudence reflects being careful about choices and not taking undue risks.

low.one_thing_to_try: Sleep on one bigger choice.

balanced.shadow: Can over- or under-think by mood.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Match caution to the size of one choice.

high.light: Careful, planful, low-regret.
high.shadow: Caution can stall into delay or timidity.
high.one_thing_to_try: Make one low-stakes choice quickly.

scales.name: Self-Regulation
scales.construct_explainer: Self-Regulation reflects managing impulses, feelings, and habits.

low.one_thing_to_try: Hold one small resolution for a week.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Remove one temptation in advance.

high.light: Strong control over impulse and habit.
high.shadow: Tight control can tip into rigidity.
high.one_thing_to_try: Let one small indulgence be fine.

scales.name: Appreciation of Beauty
scales.construct_explainer: Appreciation of Beauty reflects noticing and being moved by beauty and excellence.

low.one_thing_to_try: Stop to really look at one beautiful thing.

balanced.light: Moved by beauty now and then.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Seek out one moment of beauty.

high.light: Deeply moved by beauty and excellence.
high.shadow: Can prize the sublime over the useful.
high.one_thing_to_try: Find worth in one plain, useful thing.

scales.name: Gratitude
scales.construct_explainer: Gratitude reflects noticing and giving thanks for the good things in life.

low.shadow: May overlook what is going right.
low.one_thing_to_try: Thank one person sincerely today.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Count three good things tonight.

high.light: Keenly thankful and quick to say so.
high.shadow: Gratitude can gloss over real problems.
high.one_thing_to_try: Name one thing that genuinely needs fixing.

scales.name: Hope
scales.construct_explainer: Hope reflects expecting the best and working to bring it about.

low.light: Realistic, even guarded, about the future.
low.one_thing_to_try: Picture one realistic good outcome.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Make one small plan toward a goal.

high.light: Confident the future can be good.
high.shadow: Optimism can skip real risks.
high.one_thing_to_try: Name one risk your plan ignores.

scales.name: Humor
scales.construct_explainer: Humor reflects bringing lightness and laughter and seeing the playful side.

low.shadow: Lightness can be missing when it would help.
low.one_thing_to_try: Share one bit of lightness today.

balanced.one_thing_to_try: Find the funny side of one annoyance.

high.light: Brings fun and lifts the mood.
high.shadow: Joking can deflect from real things.
high.one_thing_to_try: Let one serious moment stay serious.

scales.name: Spirituality
scales.construct_explainer: Spirituality reflects having beliefs about meaning and purpose that shape action.

low.light: Finds meaning in the here and now.
low.shadow: May lack a larger frame in hard times.
low.one_thing_to_try: Name what gives your life meaning.

balanced.light: Holds some sense of larger purpose.
balanced.shadow: It can recede when life is busy.
balanced.one_thing_to_try: Spend ten quiet minutes on what matters.

high.light: Strong sense of meaning and purpose.
high.shadow: Conviction can close off other views.
high.one_thing_to_try: Hear one perspective unlike your own.

sections.title: Your turn
sections.prompt: Which strengths did you lead with, and do they feel true to you? Pick one signature strength to use more deliberately, and one lower strength you want to grow. Write it in your own words.
